purpose: Teach: イルカ/浴衣/包丁/ディズニーランド/玄米/披露宴/お好み焼き/田植え

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 動物園で、イルカに会いに行きたい。
lines.en: I want to go see the dolphins at the zoo.
lines.style: Open, eager warmth. Immediate and genuine. Light breath-catch on the longing—she's really picturing it. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。夏祭り、浴衣で参加するの。
lines.en: Yeah. I'm thinking of wearing a yukata to the summer festival.
lines.style: Gentle, affirming. Soft attack. She's sharing something small and real. Quiet pleasure in the image. No rush.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: カフェの包丁、新調したよ。
lines.en: We got new knives for the café, actually.
lines.style: Animated, practical. Light energy shift—this matters in a real way. A touch of satisfaction in the delivery. Natural and conversational.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 子供連れで、ディズニーランド、行きたいなあ。
lines.en: I'd really like to take some kids to Disneyland sometime.
lines.style: Wistful, tender. Slower pace. She's thinking aloud about something she wants but hasn't quite admitted to herself. Soft landing on the end—hope mixed with uncertainty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、玄米食、ハマってる。
lines.en: I've been really into eating brown rice lately.
lines.style: Reflective, measured. Thoughtful tone—she's noticing something about herself. Gentle curiosity in her voice. No performance, just genuine interest.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 友達の披露宴、来週、行く。
lines.en: I'm going to a friend's reception next week.
lines.style: Warm, cheerful. Bright forward energy. Genuinely pleased for someone else. Easy, unforced brightness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今夜、お好み焼き、家族で作るの。
lines.en: We're making okonomiyaki as a family tonight.
lines.style: Warm and present. Immediate, real delight. She's picturing the moment—the togetherness of it. Bright but grounded.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 郷里の田植え、毎年見に行ってる。
lines.en: I always go back to my hometown to watch the rice planting every year.
lines.style: Wistful, tender. Slower, more deliberate. Affection for something rooted and returning. Small pause before the phrase—she's feeling the distance and the constancy both.
